SELECT gallery.id as galleryId, gallery.title as title, gallery.match_date as matchDate, gallery_image.image_url as imageUrl, gallery.is_official as isOfficial FROM gallery LEFT JOIN ( SELECT gallery_id, MIN(id) AS image_id FROM gallery_image WHERE deleted = false GROUP BY gallery_id ) gallery_image_0 ON gallery_image_0.gallery_id = gallery.id
LEFT JOIN gallery_image ON gallery_image.id = gallery_image_0.image_id
WHERE 1=1 AND gallery.deleted = false AND gallery.club_id = #{clubId}
AND (gallery.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{listReqDto.keyword}, '%') OR DATE_FORMAT(gallery.match_date, '%Y.%m.%d') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{listReqDto.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY gallery.match_date DESC, gallery.id DESC
